name: SEO Gap Analysis Agent
description: AI-powered SEO analysis agent. Compares your site against top competitors for a target keyword, identifies gaps, and generates actionable recommendations. Payment-gated via x402 (USDC on Base Sepolia).

services.name: api
services.description: Run SEO gap analysis. POST with { url, userId, targetKeyword }. Returns runId. Poll /api/report/{runId}/status for progress. Payment required via x402 ($0.001 USDC).

services.name: status
services.description: Poll workflow progress. GET returns { status, progress, completedSteps }.

services.name: report
services.description: Fetch completed report. GET returns full report data when status is completed.
